assessments.reasoning: I independently retrieved and verified the exact bytes of Revised Report on the Algorithmic Language ALGOL 68 and inspected the cited passage (§§6.3 and 6.3.2, printed p. 94 (physical PDF p. 95)). Section 6.3 explains use for a routine without parameters. Section 6.3.2 calls the direct descendant’s yielded routine in environ E and requires the result to be no newer in scope than E for both forms.

challenge.method: Trace a parameterless routine with a yield of admissible scope and one newer than E. Read the ordinary and soft syntax alternatives, then compare dereferencing.
challenge.results: Both deproceduring alternatives use the common semantics. A yield newer than E fails the requirement. Dereferencing evaluates a name under a different coercion.

limitations: The rule applies to ordinary and soft deproceduring in the inspected Revised Report with authorized errata through 1978.
